annotations.text:
Hazri — walk-around BLE placement tool for the M5Stack nodes.
Flow: Live (what's strongest right now) → Survey (record a room) → Coverage (rooms × nodes, verdict + suggestions). Node detail opens from any node card. Tools holds calibration, beacon check, MQTT inspector, export, settings.
Key number everywhere is the MARGIN: best node minus second-best in a room. Under ~5 dB = Tight (HA will flap). No node above −85 = Blind.
Low-fi alternate, kept beside the dark direction. Say the word and I'll rebuild the five screens in this style instead.
